objective: Users have no way to delete specs, causing draft clutter and no cleanup path. Adds a delete method to SpecStore, a DELETE endpoint on the server, a delete button per spec card, and a bulk-delete-drafts action on the specs page.
outcomes: DELETE /specs/:id removes the spec JSON, MD, and report files; returns 204
Deleting the active spec returns 409 with a clear error message
Each spec card shows a trash icon button; clicking it shows a confirm dialog then calls DELETE
The specs page has a 'Clear all drafts' button that bulk-deletes all draft specs with a confirm dialog
After deletion the spec disappears from the list without a full page reload

evidence.excerpt: Add delete spec capability: SpecStore.delete() in core, DELETE /specs/:id in server, deleteSpec() in frontend API client, delete button on spec cards, bulk-delete-all-drafts button on specs page

edgeCases.scenario: User tries to delete the active spec
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Server returns 409; UI shows error toast; spec is not deleted

edgeCases.scenario: User clicks Delete then cancels the confirm dialog
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Nothing is deleted; card stays in place

edgeCases.scenario: No draft specs exist when bulk-delete is clicked
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Button is disabled or shows 'No drafts to delete'
Successfully deleted specs are removed from the list; failed ones stay with an error banner

constraints: Cannot delete a spec that is currently the active spec — must deactivate first or refuse
Deleting a spec also removes its .md file and proof report
healthMetrics: All existing server tests still pass
Frontend builds with no TypeScript errors
verification: Delete a non-active draft spec — card disappears from the list
Try to delete the active spec — error message appears, spec stays
Click Clear all drafts — all draft cards are removed
Cancel the confirm dialog — nothing changes
